_description: Baseline metrics — updated after each shipped feature. Used to track trends across sessions.

session.graphify_calls: int — number of graphify queries in the session
session.brain_docs_read: int — number of Obsidian notes read
session.test_runs: int — number of test suite executions
session.tasks_completed: int — spec tasks that reached green
session.ai_blob_score: int — functions > 40 lines without test coverage

cost.total_usd: float — real billed cost when the session transcript is found (~/.claude/projects/*/<CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID>.jsonl): sums each assistant reply's actual usage (input/output/cache tokens), deduped by reply id, at real per-model pricing — same approach ponytail's band import uses. Falls back to a rough tool-I/O-size proxy (excludes system prompt, conversation history, model response text, cache tokens — structurally undercounts) only when no transcript is found, e.g. CI. Check cost.source to tell which one a given report used.
